Q4 2025 capex = 2,629 − 1,784 = 845 (USD millions).

Pfizer doesn't report Q4 capex directly, so I calculated it as full-year 2025 minus the first nine months of 2025. I took capital expenditures to be "Purchases of property, plant and equipment" on the cash flow statement.

- Full-year 2025 purchases of property, plant and equipment were $2,629 million, from the 10-K.
- The nine-month figure through September 28, 2025 was $1,784 million, from the Q3 10-Q.

That gives $2,629 million − $1,784 million = $845 million, or about $845,000,000.
